_comment: The organizations package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/seo_analyzer_PRD.md X11, D22). One
slot the application binds in its own security.json, or startup is refused:
These rights say who may use organizations at all. Which organization's rows each user reaches, and
with which role, is data: the package's row policy (OrganizationRowPolicy) over the memberships.
Memberships are never created by a form (New is not granted); invitations are created by the
InviteOrganizationMember action and only listed and revoked here.
Drop one grant with { "key": "organizations:<key>", "$remove": true }, or all of them with
